nodes.title: Activity rows say what was done but not to what ("Asha Rao ran a practice call", not "…with Kavya"). The audit log deliberately stores only an args hash, never the args, so there is no safe name to show.
nodes.question: Should each tool declare a non-personal subject label (an agent, audience, list or campaign name, never a contact's name or number), stored in the audit payload at write time, so activity.list can name the object?
nodes.closes_when: Either: the kernel gains a per-tool subject(args, result) that returns only non-personal names, the audit payload carries it, activity.list returns it and the web renders it, with a test that no contact name or phone number ever reaches a subject. Or: the owner says the current sentences are enough.
